title: Bagram Air Base location map
subject: Geography
caption: Map showing Bagram Air Base in Parwan Province, Afghanistan, relative to Charikar and surrounding landmarks.
altText: A clear, high‑resolution textbook‑style map on a white background that highlights Parwan Province in Afghanistan. Bagram Air Base is marked with a red dot and labeled, while the town of Charikar is shown nearby and labeled. Major highways, the Kabul River, provincial borders, a north arrow, and a scale bar are also included, all with legible labels.
